## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.18.2.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.18.2.pdf** |
| A one-sheet summary to print, two-sided | **Cognitive-Terrain-Player-Aid-0.18.2.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.18.2.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.18 build (0.18.0, 0.18.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **A centred scoreboard.** The top bar now reads Blue's points, the next
  crisis, then the other side's points, in the middle of the bar. The week
  counter is gone: the timeline lights the current week. In the Minimal
  layout each side's Decision Health sits beside its points, because the
  health bars are folded away.
- **The next crisis stands out.** A sand badge names the crisis, marks the
  four crises (done, next, still to come), counts down the weeks and names
  the area it tests. It turns amber the week before and pulses in the week
  itself (not with reduced motion). It stays in view on small screens.
- **Clearer health bars.** Each side's name and score sit above a full-width
  bar that runs from 0.5 to 1, labelled .5, .72, .86 and 1, so small changes
  and the crisis cut-offs are easy to read.
- **This week's orders** sit at the foot of the left side instead of over the
  timeline.
- **The small map is bright again**, as it was before 0.18.1.
- **Dialogs in the same frame.** The start screen, Settings, Week in review,
  new technologies and crises use the framed panels, headings and buttons of
  the rest of the screen. In a crisis, Blue's result is edged blue and the
  other side's red. No more sideways scrollbar in dialogs.
- On small screens the top bar shortens a few labels to stay on one line, and
  the music and sound buttons move to Settings only.
- Tutorial, Field Manual and Player Aid updated, with every picture retaken.
  No rule changes: two-player codes work between 0.18 builds.
